Earlier, the president was reportedly forced to stay aboard Marine One at Joint Base Andrews after an emergency inflatable slide on his Air Force One — a jet "gifted" by Qatar — suddenly deployed ahead of his departure for Dallas to attend a Republican midterm convention.

"Trump is making inflation great again," the host joked, touching on a topic particularly uncomfortable for the president, who has struggled to bring it under control during his second term.
